svg.text: ToolTrie-v1 leads every ordering; a full-reuse ceiling shows the headroom
Dots: one per request, over its 40-request window. Lines: run medians per concurrency level. Brackets: ToolTrie-v1 vs no reordering.
interactivity: responses per second per user (1 / time to first token) (log scale)
the same 10 tools, so its whole
tool list is cached. Not an
Closed loop, N = 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 requests in flight, 200 requests each (2,880 dots). Each dot is the 40 requests that finished nearest to one request: median
interactivity and completion rate over that window. The first and last 20 completions per run lack a full window. Bracket gaps are read off the
median lines by linear interpolation. Source: conc-4b-p10-single-20260916-214417 + conc-4b-p10-ceiling-20260917-010805. 3 dots off-axis.
